title: Mobile
description: Can structure a Flutter app with local persistence, networking and lifecycle so defined work succeeds offline — and can show a useful UI state when the network fails.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can build a Flutter screen that reads and writes a local store, record the lifecycle hook that runs on resume, and show a loading state — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can persist a defined offline use case, surface a useful UI state on a network failure, and document the persistence model — what lives on device versus server.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently keep app, domain and data layers so a mentor can find the persistence and HTTP boundaries, cover non-UI domain behavior and key widgets with tests, and survive an app kill mid-write without losing the documented invariant.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a bug that only appears after background/resume or a flaky network, cite lifecycle and persistence together, and produce a note another Flutter engineer can follow without opening the widget tree first.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's Flutter project, name a network call that has no failure UI or a store treated as the server of record, and teach when to trust local persistence over a retry on an unfamiliar app.
